description.value: A community campground in the remote Nisga'a village of Gingolx, at the end of Highway 113 where the Nass River meets Portland Inlet — simple, locally-run facilities in a place of deep quiet, panoramic mountain views, and rich Indigenous culture, with day trips possible to Hlgu Isgwit Hot Springs and the Nisga'a Lava Bed Park. Tourism infrastructure is basic and the pace is slow, but the setting is genuinely special.

address.value: 607 Front Street, Gingolx, British Columbia, Canada V0V 1B0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Gingolx is an active tourism destination operated by the Nisga'a Village Government, with visitor information and a 'BOOK AT THE LODGE' prompt indicating ongoing tourism services. The OSM tag description ('Check in at Gingolx Administration') and the tourism=camp_site tag together confirm a community campground exists, though neither the OSM record nor the website provides campground-specific amenity details. Contact information (phone: 250-326-4212, address: 607 Front Street) was sourced entirely from the /contact subpage, as OSM contained no contact fields.
concerns: OSM record contained no phone, address, or email; all contact information sourced solely from the website /contact subpage.

The discovered URL (https://gingolx.ca/visit/) carries only medium confidence and leads to the village's general tourism page rather than a dedicated campground page — the campground appears to be one component of village-run tourism infrastructure.

A prominent 'BOOK AT THE LODGE' call-to-action appears on the visit page; it is unclear whether this refers to the campground or a separate lodge accommodation, and campground-specific booking instructions are not described on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate community campground in a remote Indigenous village at the terminus of Highway 113, offering touring cyclists a unique and culturally rich destination on BC's northwest coast with an active village government tourism operation.
enrichment_extras.notes: Per OSM description tag, check-in is at the Gingolx Administration office. OSM wheelchair=yes tag suggests accessible site, but this could not be confirmed via website content.
